152.19950,-27.68093.name: DIR 209 — Sorghum field trial (site 1), Lockyer Valley Regional Council
152.19950,-27.68093.desc: WHAT. A licensed GMO crop field trial site, Asexual seed production; Selectable markers – herbicide tolerance, visual marker, held by The University of Queensland. WHERE IT SITS. OGTR named the council area this site is in and published no coordinate on the page this was read from, so this marker sits in that council area and not at the trial itself. WHY IT MATTERS. OGTR names the council area of every licensed site, its area in hectares and the licence it runs under. No other register on this map states where a release is at all, which is the comparison worth making even at this resolution.

-81.87780,26.55970.name: Specialists in Reproductive Medicine & Surgery, PA, Embryo Donation International, PL
-81.87780,26.55970.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Craig R. Sweet, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-95.36770,29.75894.name: Baylor College of Medicine and VAMC

An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. -106.25000,34.84000.name: VA Medical Center #501
-106.25000,34.84000.type: Animal Welfare Act veterans affairs hospital
-106.25000,34.84000.desc: Veterans Affairs hospital registered with USDA APHIS under the Animal Welfare Act, certificate 85-V-0001. This is the address on the registration. A research registration is issued to an organisation rather than to a building, so for a university it is usually the research administration office and the animals are elsewhere on campus or in another city. Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

-35.90671,-7.23131.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.fertliv.com.br. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-84.50400,38.03000.name: MosquitoMate
-84.50400,38.03000.desc: Releases male mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia bacteria so that their matings produce no offspring, sold as a commercial mosquito control service in US cities. The insects are not genetically engineered, which is why the product reached market with far less friction than an engineered equivalent — the same suppression outcome, achieved by a route the rules were not written to catch.

77.23950,28.62250.name: Monsanto v. Nuziveedu — a seed patent in India
77.23950,28.62250.state: New Delhi — Supreme Court of India
77.23950,28.62250.desc: The Indian Supreme Court restored in 2019 the patent claim over Bt cotton technology that the High Court had struck down, sending the substantive question back for trial. The dispute matters beyond India because Indian law excludes plants and seeds from patentability while allowing patents on the genetic construct, and the argument over where that line falls governs whether a seed patent means anything in the country with the most cotton farmers.
